item.title: Tokorozawa Sakura Town: A Pop Culture & Architecture Complex — Guide
item.description: Tokorozawa Sakura Town is a large cultural complex developed by publishing giant Kadokawa, its centrepiece the striking Kadokawa Culture Museum — an angular, faceted stone building designed by architect Kengo Kuma that houses exhibitions spanning manga, anime, literature, and Japanese pop culture, alongside a vast bookshelf-lined library space. The complex also includes a shrine dedicated to anime and manga characters, event spaces and a hotel, making it a distinctive modern counterpoint to Saitama’s more traditional attractions.
